meta.title: Metis AI Research: a small team that ships, running on AI

hero.sub: Metis AI Research is a studio in Vancouver. We build and operate live products, arotaro and Blinc, with AI employees working alongside us.
hero.shotAlt: Metis OS, the system we run the company on, showing the Blinc project and the integrations its AI employees can use.
hero.shotCaption: Metis OS, our internal operating system, in daily use.

who.heading: Our vision
who.statement: We believe AI’s highest purpose is making ordinary moments better, and that the AI era needs companies that build with care.
who.body1: Metis AI Research was founded in Vancouver to change how people live and work through AI-powered products. Personalized learning, intelligent assistants, tools that make complex tasks simple: we focus on experiences that lift daily life and stay out of the way when they should.
who.body2: We believe AI can improve almost every part of life, and we’re building quietly toward that future, one product at a time.

products.heading: Two products, live today.
products.sub: Each one is designed, shipped and run by the four of us.

arotaro.tagline: A mental wellness companion: tarot, astrology and fortune telling in a safe space to talk through whatever’s on your mind. Counselling at your fingertips, 24/7.
arotaro.mockUser1: I’ve been feeling stuck lately. Can you pull a card?
arotaro.mockAi1: Of course. Take a breath. I drew The Star for you, a sign of quiet hope after a hard stretch. What feels heaviest right now?
arotaro.mockUser2: Work. I can’t tell if I’m burnt out or just lost.
arotaro.mockAi2: That sounds heavy. Let’s pull one more card, for what you need this week, and go from there.

blinc.tagline: Every loyalty card, one tap away. Blinc keeps your rewards and membership cards in one fast, private place. Tap a card and the barcode fills the screen, ready to scan. Works offline, needs no account, and your cards never leave your phone.
blinc.demoLabel: Try it: tap a card to show its barcode

howWeBuild.heading: People and AI employees, one team.
howWeBuild.body1: Metis OS is the operating system we built to run Metis. Our AI employees work there alongside us: answering questions, writing the morning numbers, planning roadmaps, and keeping every product we run in good shape.
howWeBuild.body2: It’s how a team our size ships and operates more than one product, and it’s where we learn first-hand what working with AI actually takes. Those lessons go straight back into everything we build.
howWeBuild.flowLabel: How a change moves through Metis OS

flow.title: Feedback arrives
flow.body: From users, reviews and the team.

flow.title: An agent proposes a plan
flow.body: It triages the feedback and drafts the work.

flow.title: A person approves
flow.body: Nothing gets built without a yes.

flow.title: It ships
flow.body: And the AI employees keep it running.

pillars.title: AI employees
pillars.body: Agents with installable skills that research, answer and write, on request or on a schedule.

pillars.title: Reports you can trust
pillars.body: Daily digests built from queries a person approved, so the numbers mean the same thing every day.

pillars.title: Roadmaps, planned together
pillars.body: Agents triage feedback and propose plans. A person approves before anything gets built.

pillars.title: One door to every product
pillars.body: The operating surface for each product we run, arotaro and Blinc included.

howWeBuild.note: Metis OS is internal and in daily use at Metis.

principles.title: AI should feel inevitable, not impressive.
principles.body: The best technology disappears. We don’t build demos for the AI era. We build products that feel obvious in hindsight, the kind you can’t imagine living without a month after you start using them.

principles.title: Personalization is a craft, not a feature.
principles.body: Every product we create is shaped to your actual life, whether that’s learning, productivity or wellbeing. Generic AI is loud; personal AI is quiet and precise. We choose precision.

principles.title: Small teams with strong taste outperform big teams with big budgets.
principles.body: We are a small team building with focus and conviction. The future belongs to teams that care about the details other people skip.
